welcome_offer.description: Variable welcome offer: up to 100,000 Membership Rewards® points ("apply and find out your welcome offer, as high as 100,000") after you spend $8,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 6 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer; American Express shows the exact amount after you apply. No fixed public offer amount is published.
notes: Issuer page is canonical; community/secondary sources may show stale or targeted spend requirements.
